name: Paperless-ngx
tagline: Scan, OCR, index, and never lose a document
description: Document management with OCR and tagging. Turn paper into a searchable archive.
compose:
services:
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - ./media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ${{cfg.consume_dir}}:/usr/src/paperless/consume
    environment:
      PAPERLESS_REDIS: redis://redis:6379
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
